correctness.rationale: Permutation uniqueness reduces shape to aP+bH, a,b>0 and center t*1. Exact halfspace support yields s^2=((n-1)a+b)/n, s<=t, s<=1-t, nt+sqrt(nb)<=tau. At fixed t the determinant maximizer is b=min(t^2,n(tau/n-t)^2); the logarithmic derivative on the rank-active branch has sign tau-(n+1)t and its global maximizer is t=min(tau/(n+1),1/2). These exact inequalities produce all three displayed parameter regions and matching boundaries. Independent substitution checked n=2 and representative n,tau including transitions; the argument, not samples, proves arbitrary n and real tau.
